programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1735

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1736

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Ett år etter innspillingen møtes hotellgjestene igjen for å snakke ut om allianser, svik, intriger og romanser. Det blir en intens gjenforening, med sterke følelser og uforløste konflikter.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Fem gutter inntar hotellet og får velge sin første partner etter en intens koffertsjekk. Ett par blir satt i fare, og spillet er i gang når den ellevte gjesten sjekker inn.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 704
programme.desc: Første deltaker elimineres fra Camp kulinaris. Det er klart for en fysisk krevende lærlingkamp før to deltakere møtes i årets første kokkekamp - der én må overvinne sin egen frykt for å lykkes.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 705
programme.desc: Det er ny uke på Camp Kulinaris, og alle er spente på hvem som blir ukens restaurantsjef. Stå-på-viljen er det ingenting å si på, men hvor lenge vil det egentlig vare?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 706
programme.desc: Restaurantsjefen får en brå og start på dagen som setter hele gjengen på ustø kurs mot menysmakingen. Det blir dårlig stemning når flere deltagere later som at retten deres har blitt kvalitetssjekket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 707
programme.desc: Kommunikasjonen bryter fullstendig sammen når restaurantsjefen går inn i "dictator mode". Kjartan og gjesten blir helt glemt, og hvorfor i all verden klapper gjestene i hendene og roper BABEK?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 708
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag, og en ny deltaker skal sendes hjem. Lærlingkampen blir avgjort med minst mulig margin når smaksløker og brekningrefleks utfordres hos flere av deltakerne.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 709
programme.desc: Flere vil bli restaurantsjef, men lysten snus raskt til frustrasjon når det blir klart at gruppen deles i to lag. To nye deltagere ankommer, men blir det en større forbannelse enn glede for lagene?

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1001

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 105

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Roger tar turen til akvariet i Las Palmas for å se på hai. Svein drar til en helseresort for å få bukt med gamle ulumskheter. Damene besøker en softgun-arena, mens Inger er på jakt etter en solhatt.

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 104

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 908

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1002

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 106

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 309
programme.desc: Oppussingskvartetten dra til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt. til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 206

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Richard feirer 40-årsdagen til den ikoniske Ferrari Daytona, og en Nissan GT-R får kjørt seg på Japans legendariske Fuji Speedway.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Tinas planer om å dra til OL blir utfordret når hesten hennes er med om en ulykke. Karina og Tina bestemmer seg for å invitere alle fruene på et spaopphold på et nytt hotell.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Alle er travelt opptatt med juleforberedelsene. Det er Tina og familiens første ordentlige danske jul, og Janni har store planer om å arrangere en julelunsj for alle fruene på Vedbæklund.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Amalie fyller år, og Janni arrangerer en overraskelsesfest for henne og de andre fruene, men hvordan blir det å samles igjen etter konflikten mellom Janni og Gunnvør?

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Tina og Allan har bestemt seg for å skaffe en hund, og spesielt Louis blir positivt overrasket. I mellomtiden skal Karsten delta i et løp for veteranbiler.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Janni skal gjøre en viktig og avgjørende undersøkelse av lungene, som hun er veldig nervøs over. Tina skal gifte seg igjen og har bestemt seg for å finne den perfekte brudekjolen ved hjelp av Jackie og Gunnvør.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Tina og familien hennes har dratt til Ibiza for å fornye hennes og Allans bryllupsløfter. Hjemme står Jackie i et stort dilemma angående den kommende mageoperasjonen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3103
programme.desc: Gayles økonomi er så trang at hun ikke lenger kan sove om natten. Stresset over at sønnen hennes lider når hun må jobbe de bedre betalte helge- og dagvaktene er konstant til stede.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3104
programme.desc: 22 år gamle Moa satte seg selv i en skikkelig dårlig økonomisk situasjon, da hun havnet i en periode hvor festing og reising ble viktigere enn å gå på jobb. Magnus drar nå til Gotland for å få orden på situasjonen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3105
programme.desc: Magnus drar til Gävle for å bryte 30 år gamle Daniels mønster, når det kommer til å bruke penger han ikke har. Akkurat nå er det så ille at gjelden hans hver måned er høyere enn inntekten.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3106
programme.desc: Fembarnsfaren Martins pengebruk kjenner ingen grenser. Det meste han eier er kjøpt på kreditt, og nå har samboeren Jessica fått nok og meldt på samboeren på Luksusfellen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3107
programme.desc: Luksusfellen besøker Magnus som lever uten strøm i hjemmet sitt, en prioritering han har gjort de siste månedene når pengene ikke har strekt til. Ettersom det blir kaldere om natten, risikerer huset nå å få kuldeskader.

programme.title: Small Time Crooks
programme.desc: Ray Winkler (Woody Allen) er en ekskjeltring med store drømmer og med en manglende evne til å holde på oppvaskejobbene. Hans kone Frenchy (Tracey Ullman) er en sardonisk manikyrist som tøyler Ray i et forsøk på å få han ned på jorden.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad (Ben Stiller) lever et komfortabelt liv i et villastrøk i Sacramento sammen med sin godmodige kone (Jenna Fischer) og sønnen (Austin Abrams). Livet forandres da han blir gjenforent med sine gamle venner.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: I fremtiden deler menneskene hvert aspekt av livene sine med sofistikerte ledsagerroboter. Men da et robotbarn ved navn Davis programmeres til å vise betingelsesløs kjærlighet, er ikke menneskefamilien hans forberedt på konsekvensene.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: Proxima
programme.desc: Astronauten Sarah forbereder seg til et års langt oppdrag på Den Internasjonale Romstasjonen. I det siste oppdraget før ferden til mars, er det mye som står på spill, ikke minst privat. Eva Green spiller hovedrollen som Astronauten Sarah Loreau.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Guilty By Suspicion
programme.desc: Denne fengslende historien gjenskaper Hollywoods beryktede ”svartelisteepoke”. Heksejakten er i gang, og regissøren David Merrill kan igjen få fart på karrieren ved å vitne mot venner som er mistenkt for å være kommunister.

programme.title: Fire never i Rio
programme.desc: De rike fetterne Antonio og Sebastiano Coimbra er to brasilianske mangemillionærer som lever i frykt for yrkesmordere. Derfor ansetter de to dobbeltgjengere, Greg Wonder som er en kriminelt belastet saxofonspiller, og stuntmannen Eliot Vance.

programme.title: Midnight in Paris
programme.desc: Paris om morgenen er vakker. Paris om ettermiddagen er sjarmerende. Paris om kvelden er fortryllende. Men - Paris etter midnatt er magisk!

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush er basert på Bill Keenans bestselgende, komiske selvbiografi af samme navn. Den amerikanske ishockeyspiller Bobby Sanders fra Harvard blir solgt til en div. 1. klubb i Sverige for en vaskemaskin.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Let's Go Crazy
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir fortvilet når hun får vite at et intervju har fått objektet til å begå selvmord. SNC reagerer med å stenge Talk Back, noe som setter Mark i en ubekvem stilling.

programme.title: Twenties: Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing
programme.desc: Et jordskjelv påvirker vennskapet. Marie blir på vakt for Chuck når en pornokveld tar av. Hattie blir mer begeistret for Ida når hun sorterer gamle manuskript, noe som fører til en åpenhjertig samtale som er både intim og elskverdig.

programme.title: Twenties: Redemption Song
programme.desc: Hattie får lære å balansere arbeid og familie. Arbeidet fører Nia til kirken for å rydde opp i Zacs rot, og overtaler stjernebasketspilleren Quintrelle til å tegne kontrakt med studioet.

programme.title: Twenties: What Would Todd Do?
programme.desc: I improvisasjonstimen kjemper Nia med å få stereotype svarte roller. Marie blir rasende over Ben blir forfremmet foran henne, og leter etter svar. Hattie prøver å gjøre sin stemme hørt i forfatterrommet.

programme.title: Twenties: Living The Dream
programme.desc: I et modig forsøk på å gi Nia en rolle i Cocoa's Butter, blir Hattie sparket fra serien. Marie avholder en spesiell fødselsdagsmiddag som får en vri når en uventet gjest dukker opp.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: One Is The Loneliest Number
programme.desc: Mary Jane og kollegene rystes av en dødelig skoleskyting i Atlanta.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Line In The Sand
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir nominert for Emmy-prisen, og må søke råd hos gode venner. Tidsnok må hun bestemme seg for å ta sjansen og følge instinktet. Samtidig blir informasjon om Tracy kjent.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Primetime
programme.desc: Cynthia er syk og Mary Jane og Kara leder og produserer et nyhetsprogram i beste sendetid. Av andre begivenheter velger Paul jr. arbeidstilbud.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 907
programme.desc: Fru Tishells unge kusine Sarah Cardy skygger henne på jobb for å få litt arbeidserfaring.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 908
programme.desc: Bryllupsklokkene ringer i Portwenn før Morwenna og Als bryllup. Men noen siste liten problemer truer med spolere dagen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ting har endret seg i Portwenn. Martin jobber ikke lenger som lege, men tar seg av Mary Elizabeth og James Henry, og det er Louisa som tar imot klienter.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Klinikken i Portwenn er åpen igjen! Men det går ikke like knirkefritt med den nye resepsjonisten Max bak pulten.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Martin blir kalt til en nødsituasjon på en lokal gård, men til hans irritasjon ser den syke bonden Ron ut til å være frisk nok til å stelle sauene sine.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Martin råder fru Moore til å slutte å svømme i kaldt vann til de vet årsaken til migrene hennes. Mrs. Tishell prøver å hjelpe fordi hun vet at det er en måte for henne å komme nær sin avdøde ektemann.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: The Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Terry Woldmeyer er en skarp forstadsfrue som blir sittende alene med ansvaret for de fire egenrådige døtrene sine da ektemannen plutselig forlater henne.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close Shave
programme.desc: Kris is reunited with Wildfire in time to race on the world's biggest stage, in the Breeders Invitational Stakes.

programme.title: Wildfire: Fairy Tale Endings
programme.desc: In the third-season premiere, Kris learns what happened to Kerry while Raintree deals with the unexpected fallout of the Breeders' Cup win.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Feud
programme.desc: Kris resorts to desperate measures to ease Raintree's financial crisis.

programme.title: Wildfire: Moving On
programme.desc: Kris has a falling-out with Jean over Wildfire's readiness to race again.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close To Home
programme.desc: The destruction of Kris's trailer by fire forces her to move into the Ritters' house, which brings her closer to an old flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: Love Vs. Work
programme.desc: Kris is distracted by the return of her rival, Tina Sharp (Amy Jo Johnson), who is tapped to ride a Raintree boarder's horse that used to belong to the Davis ranch.

programme.title: A Sisterly Christmas

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
programme.desc: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fractured Glass
programme.desc: When affable ladies’ man Michael Tittemore is gunned down in the dead of night, Kenda first sets his sights on the roommates who were present during the murder.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Will Hunt You Down
programme.desc: When two escaped inmates surface in Colorado Springs, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda and his Fugitive Unit to bring them to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Stuck In A Coffin
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a five-alarm fire, first responders discover a lifeless body. When Kenda learns that the deadly blaze was no accident, he launches a manhunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Highway
programme.desc: One is dead and two are in critical condition, and it’s up to Kenda and Barry to find out why a gun battle occurred in a quaint family home.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Comes Knocking
programme.desc: Neighbors are aghast when Ernestine Addison and her teen son Bobby are gunned down in cold blood. The case heats up when Kenda receives word that the killer’s murderous rampage isn’t over just yet.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lock the Door
programme.desc: Soon after the lifeless body of Charlie Tuttle was discovered behind a locked bedroom door, his death was ruled a suicide. But six months later, Kenda receives an unprompted confession .

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
programme.desc: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programme.desc: A five-year-old boy claims that his imaginary friend pushed his sister through a second story window. A newly divorced woman relives the terrifying history of the remote cabin she's rented.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programme.desc: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: The Axe Murderer
programme.desc: An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: An Entity in Bed
programme.desc: An entity jumps into a woman's bed and lies down beside her; two sisters' ghosts roam a Civil War-era house; a castle built on an old Indian burial ground is haunted by its original owner; and more.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Van Horn Mansion
programme.desc: Nick tries to contact a spirit to see if she'll reveal her cause of death.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Gjengen tilbringer kvelden med å fullføre sine prosjekter ved Ridgeway under den årlige skole-innlåsingen. Carly og Freddie mistenker at Sam er forelsket i sin nye venn Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty med Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistenker at den nye typen hennes, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så gjengen planlegger en tur til Los Angeles for å ta ham på fersken på en fest som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjelpen
programme.desc: Carly trår til for å løse en krangel mellom Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for å få hjelp med hver eneste krangel. Nå som hun har involvert seg, hvordan kan Carly trekke seg ut av det igjen?

programme.title: iCarly: Det holder
programme.desc: Mrs Benson oppdager Sam og Freddies forhold etter at Gibby - som nå er mål for Sams hevn - har lagt planer om å splitte dem. Kommer Carly til å slåss for Sam og Freddie, eller hjelpe Gibby med å få dem til å gå fra hverandre?

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg elsker deg
programme.desc: Carly ber Sam og Freddie om å prøve hverandres yndlingshobbier. I mens treffer Spencer på sin gamle barnevakt og ber henne ut på middag. Etter at de har falt inn i sine gamle roller igjen, kommer de fortsatt til å kunne være sammen?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved å prøve å virke smartere enn hun er. Og gjengen prøver å finne et nytt sted å bo til T-Bo, etter at han har blitt kastet ut av Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Møtet med førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynner å undersøke iCarly-gjengen etter at de hacker seg inn på et sikkerhetsnettverk for å holde nettfødselsdag for Carlys far. Gjestestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Billetten
programme.desc: Gjengen, minus Carly, tar med Sam til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men oppdager så at Sam ikke får komme tilbake inn i USA. I mens får Carly bekymringer i badekaret når hun gjør seg klar til daten sin.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Yakima
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Komidrama om tenåringen Jenna Hamilton. Jenna er tilsynelatende usynlig for resten av skolen, helt til hun blir berømt etter at folk feilaktig tror at hun har prøvd å begå selvmord.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Komidrama om tenåringen Jenna Hamilton. Jenna er tilsynelatende usynlig for resten av skolen, helt til hun blir berømt etter at folk feilaktig tror at hun har prøvd å begå selvmord.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna unngår å tenke på at det var moren hennes som skrev konfrontasjonsbrevet og konsentrerer seg heller om å skape julestemning, til Jakes julegave tvinger henne til å avgjøre om hun er klar til å legge fortiden med Matty bak seg.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna gleder seg over at forholdet til Jake endelig er offisielt, helt til hun får høre om de skjulte kameraopptakene. Hun gjør sitt beste for å ødelegge opptaket der hun ber Ming og de andre om hjelp.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å slutte fred med Matty og glede Jake, men har problemer med ignorere Mattys flørting. Oppførselen hans får henne til å lure på hvem som egentlig er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna kommer ikke over foreldrenes separasjon og føler seg ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøk på å tilgi seg selv søker hun hjelp fra høyere makter på en kirkeleir.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder seg på sin første valentinsdag med kjæreste, men både hun og Tamara blir sjalu ved tanken på at eksene deres kanskje er kommet over dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna kommer ikke over Jakes kjærlighetserklæring og lurer på om hun vil finne ut av følelsene sine dersom hun har sex med ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er endelig sikker på hva hun føler for Jake og fast bestemt på at tiden er inne. Hun støter imidlertid på hindringer i form av tante Allys bryllup, en mann fra morens fortid, og renkesmeden Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og en serie avsløringer gjør både Jenna og Jake sønderknuste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Das Negroes

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom

programme.title: Key & Peele: Flicker

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Fem gutter inntar hotellet og får velge sin første partner etter en intens koffertsjekk. Ett par blir satt i fare, og spillet er i gang når den ellevte gjesten sjekker inn.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: En ny gjest sjekker inn og flere av jentene settes i stor fare. En tilsynelatende uskyldig lek skaper drama i gruppen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Martine dukker uventet opp på hotellet. Rangeringen på festen fører til at en av jentene må sjekke ut før sesongens første parseremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Kjærligheten har inntatt hotellet, og en ny kjekkas sjekker inn. Jentene fristes, og et partnerskap slår sprekker.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Alt er lov i krig og kjærlighet – eller? Enda en gjest sjekker inn og skaper trøbbel i paradis. To gutter står nå i fare og må kjempe for sine plasser på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Ett par får en stor makt som skaper usikkerhet i gjengen. Hvem ender opp med det sorte hjertet og må sjekke ut før parseremonien?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 901
programme.desc: Toppblogger Isabel Raad har tidligere leid leilighet for 29 000 kr i måneden. Nå skal hun kjøpe sin aller første bolig, men klarer Karianne å finne noe som kan leve opp til de skyhøye forventningene?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 709
programme.desc: Flere vil bli restaurantsjef, men lysten snus raskt til frustrasjon når det blir klart at gruppen deles i to lag. To nye deltagere ankommer, men blir det en større forbannelse enn glede for lagene?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 710
programme.desc: Frustrasjonen er stor hos ett av lagene når én deltaker sover bort formiddagen i stedet for å hjelpe til. Begge lag gjør store feil, og de to restaurantsjefene frykter å måtte lage årets snack.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 711
programme.desc: Lagene stresser ved avreise til Kragerø, og én av restaurantsjefene lar konkurranseinstinktet styre mens han ser motstanderlaget forlate Portør uten en avgjørende del av utstyret sitt.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 712
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp kulinaris, og den tapende restaurantsjefen skal i kokkekamp. Hvem av de tidligere lagkompisene som må møte ham, blir avgjort i en intens lærlingkamp.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 713
programme.desc: Ny uke, ny restaurantsjef. men først ankommer en gruppe utfordrere. Ukas meny blir utfordrende. Deltakerne får beskjed om å øve mye, men det er særlig én deltager som sliter med fokuset.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 714
programme.desc: Deltagerne gjør sitt ytterste, men mye går galt. For første gang virker det sannsynlig at “Årets snack” må på menyen i tillegg til alle de andre rettene. Klarer deltagerne hale menysmakingen i land?

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Svein har reist ned helt alene og forviklingene er i gang når han skal kjøpe gave til sin venninne Linni Meister som skal feriere sammen med ham. Per og Bahareh tar seg en tur på vannscooter.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Ekteparet Bjørge og Tove drar på en romantisk middag og mimrer tilbake til da de var nyforelsket. Svein og Linni besøker en vingård og familien fra Harstad tester ut turistfenomenet Segway.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1010

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1105
programme.desc: Karina, Janni, Jackie, Gunnvør og Tina drar på jentetur til den vakre byen Venezia. Venezia viser seg imidlertid å være litt vanskelig å manøvrere i, og noen av fruene ender opp med å gå seg vill.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1106
programme.desc: Mens de andre damene koser seg i Italia, blir Amalie med moren Lotte på et deilig slottsopphold hjemme i Danmark. Amalies to døtre Josephine og Hannah er også med, men det byr på noen utfordringer.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1107
programme.desc: Tinas nye hjem blir utsatt for innbrudd. Amalie og Karina drar til et holistisk retreat for å gi slipp på dårlige energier.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Janni og Karstens kjære hund Lola skal opereres. Janni er veldig nervøs før inngrepet – spesielt når hun oppdager hvor ung veterinæren er.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Amalie har invitert alle fruene på lunsj for å møte lille baby Hannah for første gang. Alle gleder seg til å se hverandre igjen, men hvordan vil de håndtere Janni?

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3107
programme.desc: Luksusfellen besøker Magnus som lever uten strøm i hjemmet sitt, en prioritering han har gjort de siste månedene når pengene ikke har strekt til. Ettersom det blir kaldere om natten, risikerer huset nå å få kuldeskader.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3108
programme.desc: Philip begynte allerede i ung alder å tjene gode penger på jobben som selger. Men en dag mistet Philip jobben, og for å fortsette å opprettholde livet han var vant til, begynte han å ta opp lån.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3109
programme.desc: Cecilia har ikke nok kunnskap til å få orden på gjelden sin, som har hengt over henne i mange år. Men når hennes verste mareritt en dag blir til virkelighet, innser Cecilia at nå trenger hun virkelig hjelp.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige
programme.desc: Tobarnsmoren Mira har alltid ønsket andre vel. Så mye at hun selv har havnet i skyggen. Spikeren i kista var da hun tok opp et større lån for en annen person og hun selv kort tid etter ble sykemeldt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3201
programme.desc: Reza og Kati, krangler hver måned i dagene før lønnen kommer, og økonomien er så hardt presset at de nå er tvunget til å kjøpe mat og bleier på kreditt. Til tross for dette er skapene fulle av dyr elektronikk.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3202
programme.desc: Til tross for tidligere gjeldsordning har ikke 55 år gamle Maggan i Eslöv lært å styre økonomien og i dag har både venner og familie blitt preget av situasjonen ved å ha gått god for henne.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: I fremtiden deler menneskene hvert aspekt av livene sine med sofistikerte ledsagerroboter. Men da et robotbarn ved navn Davis programmeres til å vise betingelsesløs kjærlighet, er ikke menneskefamilien hans forberedt på konsekvensene.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: En spøkelseshistorie som spenner over to verdener, med mer enn et århundre fra hverandre. Når 13 år gamle Tolly finner ut at han på mystisk vis kan reise mellom de to, begynner han på et eventyr som låser opp familiehemmeligheter

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står overfor den ultimate vennskapstesten når bestevennen hans (Jason Biggs) vil at han skal ta med ekskjæresten hans (Kate Hudson) ut på en dårlig date, for å understreke at han selv er en bra kjæreste.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: Guilty By Suspicion
programme.desc: Denne fengslende historien gjenskaper Hollywoods beryktede ”svartelisteepoke”. Heksejakten er i gang, og regissøren David Merrill kan igjen få fart på karrieren ved å vitne mot venner som er mistenkt for å være kommunister.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og Oscar®-vinneren Rachel Weisz spiller hovedrollene i regissør Darren Aronofskys tidløse fabel om en manns søken etter Livets tre.

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush er basert på Bill Keenans bestselgende, komiske selvbiografi af samme navn. Den amerikanske ishockeyspiller Bobby Sanders fra Harvard blir solgt til en div. 1. klubb i Sverige for en vaskemaskin.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hva er merkeligere enn det store hullet som åpner seg i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv. Kjærligheten, virker det som.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: Tully er regissert av Jason Reitman og manuset skrevet av Diablo Cody, duoen som tidligere har laget Juno og Young Adults.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Primetime
programme.desc: Cynthia er syk og Mary Jane og Kara leder og produserer et nyhetsprogram i beste sendetid. Av andre begivenheter velger Paul jr. arbeidstilbud.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night One
programme.desc: Livene til fem barndomsvenner fra Roxbury-prosjektet i Massachusetts endrer seg for alltid når de danner en sanggruppe for å vinne en lokal talentkonkurranse. Til slutt blir de det legendariske R&B-bandet New Edition.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes fraser blir virale og gjør henne til en sensasjon over natten. Sheldon kjemper med å ta forholdet deres til neste nivå. Kara drar for å hjelpe til med et komplisert familieproblem.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul virker å ha alt; intelligens, driv, et pent hjem, sportsbil og en overdådig garderobe med designersko. Tross det mangler noe i hennes amerikanske drøm - en egen familie.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: Mary Jane hastes på sykehus etter ulykken og familien flokkes rundt henne. Paul sr. håndterer David og Helen befrir dem for Lisa. Kara kjemper for Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Martin råder fru Moore til å slutte å svømme i kaldt vann til de vet årsaken til migrene hennes. Mrs. Tishell prøver å hjelpe fordi hun vet at det er en måte for henne å komme nær sin avdøde ektemann.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Louisa blir sjokkert når hun finner faren Terry på kjøkkenet deres. Etter å ha ikke sett ham på flere år, er hun mistenksom på den virkelige grunnen til at han er tilbake i Portwenn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Martin og Louisa drar til London for at Martin skal presentere forskningsrapporten sin som hovedtaler på Imperial College Obstetrics Conference, mens Janice tar seg av barna.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1007
programme.desc: Nyheten om Martins jobbtilbud på Imperial College flyr gjennom landsbyen som en ild i tørt gress, etter at en servitør overhører Martin avsløre tilbudet til Chris Parsons på bursdagsmiddagen hans.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 1008
programme.desc: Til salgs-skiltet er oppe utenfor Portwenn Surgery. Før de drar til London, arrangerer familien Ellingham et flyttesalg for å samle inn penger til livbåtene. En urmaker har kommet for å se Martins klokker.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlegger finner kjærligheten mens hun jobber med å arrangere det siste bryllupet på en historisk taverna.

programme.title: Wildfire: Love Vs. Work
programme.desc: Kris is distracted by the return of her rival, Tina Sharp (Amy Jo Johnson), who is tapped to ride a Raintree boarder's horse that used to belong to the Davis ranch.

programme.title: Wildfire: Kiss Kiss
programme.desc: Kris is overcome by emotion when she helps Matt and Junior try to save Flame from being sold by Junior's dad.

programme.title: Wildfire: Push Me/Pull You
programme.desc: Kris worries about her status at Raintree after Gillian moves into the bunkhouse with Matt and begins offering unsolicited advice about Wildfire's training.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Merry Kissmas
programme.desc: Kayla og Carlton er på grensen til å slå opp, mest fordi Carlton behandler henne som sin assistent. Så har Kayla et spontant kyss med Dustin, og tror at hun endelig har møtt sin sanne kjærlighet.

programme.title: Memories of Christmas
programme.desc: Når Noelle arver morens hus, oppdager hun at moren hennes hadde ansatt Dave for å dekorere huset til jul. Klarar han å overbevise henne om å fortsette tradisjonen og få tilbake julegleden?

programme.title: Christmas is You
programme.desc: En kontorassistent står overfor et dilemma når sjefen hennes ber henne overbevise ekskjæresten sin om å signere med labelen deres, eller se etter en ny jobb.

programme.title: Christmas Mix
programme.desc: En kynisk radiovert havner i en krangel på lufta med sin medprogramleder, som er en håpløs romantiker. Snart er deres fiendtlige forhold et samtaleemne i hele byen.

programme.title: Just my Luck
programme.desc: Lindsay Lohan er strålende somAshley, Manhattans heldigste jente. Men hun aner ikke atlykken skal til å snu seg.Når hun kysser ulykkesfuglen Jake på en fest.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: A Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: Når de blir tvunget til å jobbe sammen, lærer to eventarrangører at motsetninger kan skape de mest uventede resultatene. Jessica, en alenemamma og bryllupsfikser - Adam, en rivaliserende festfikser som ikke kan huske det siste bryllupet han var i.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: Samantha is re-assigned to host Heartwaves, a feel-good love song show with a segment that reunites lost loves, and is less than impressed. But when charming Jake calls in, Samantha is determined to help. Will Samantha shy away, or follow her heart?

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Lotto Fever
programme.desc: Johnny is kidnapped by a loser convinced that the psychic ruined his life by helping him win the Lotto.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Symmetry
programme.desc: Johnny has trouble keeping track of his identity when visions from an attacker, a victim and a rescuer confuse the psychic's sense of reality.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
programme.desc: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
programme.desc: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
programme.desc: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
programme.desc: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

programme.title: Scorpion: The Old College Try
programme.desc: Team Scorpion går undercover på et universitet for å finne en hacker som infiltrerer Federal Reserve og truer med å kollapse verdensøkonomien.

programme.title: Scorpion: Dam Breakthrough
programme.desc: På julaften må Team Scorpion forhindre en katastrofe når styrtregn skaper en stor sprekk i en demning, som truer med å utslette en hel by i dens kjølvann.

programme.title: Scorpion: White Out
programme.desc: For å redde en amerikansk spesialstyrkeenhet fra en sikker død, må Team Scorpion trosse bitende minusgrader i Antarktis.

programme.title: Scorpion: Sun of a Gun
programme.desc: Sylvester står ansikt til ansikt med sin fraværende far, en pensjonert general, som ber Team Scorpion om hjelp, overbevist om at en diktator i Afrika har funnet et masseødeleggelsesvåpen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Da Bomb
programme.desc: Team Scorpion har i oppgave å hjelpe NASAs topphemmelige rakettoppskyting, men de må sabotere sitt eget oppdrag når Walters date fra forrige kveld har en bombe festet til brystet hennes.

programme.title: Scorpion: Fractured
programme.desc: Etter at et kraftig jordskjelv rammer Los Angeles, må Team Scorpion fikse en fastklemt gassledning for å forhindre en massiv eksplosjon.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team conducts an undercover sting to locate a cyber crime lord, but the operation is foiled by a charming, brilliant hacker whose desire to take over the online black markets puts him in a dangerous online turf war that could lead to murder.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While tracking down a felon running a heroin ring inside a prison, Agent Ian Edgerton becomes a murder suspect when the informant he meets with ends up dead, sending a desperate Edgerton over the edge when he takes a member of Don's team hostage.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When robbers hit a diamond exchange and take hostages, Don and the team find an unlikely ally in convict John Buckley, who may help the team's investigation when they believe the men are copying Buckley's criminal strategies.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When the team foils a robbery of an armored car full of Federal Reserve money and recover bills that trace back to the infamous D.B. Cooper heist, they call on Agent Roger Bloom, who worked on the Cooper case, for help with the investigation.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team try their luck at investigating the theft of scratch-off lottery tickets, but the stakes are raised when one of the culprits killed at a botched robbery turns out to be a former lottery winner.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team searches for a lost shipment of high-caliber firearms when one of the weapons is responsible for random killings throughout the city. Also, Charlie and Amita disagree on a wedding date while Don re-evaluates his relationship with Robin.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man And His Dream
programme.desc: En bildesigner utfordrer hele bilindustrien med sine revolusjonerende bildesign.

programme.title: The Curse of the Jade Scorpion

programme.desc: The IMF must get hold of a hoard of Nazi gold through four young men, sons of Hitler's top aides, who are sent to Switzerland to meet for the first time and pool their parts of the "puzzle" together.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Reluctant Dragon
programme.desc: Dr. Cherlotov, a scientist of an enemy power, failed to defect to the West when his wife did. Now that he has developed a cheap, effective anti-ballistic system, the IMF is ordered to get him out.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Frame
programme.desc: Gangster Jack Wellman is moving syndicated crime into politics, killing off certain politicians and replacing them with men more sympathetic to the Syndicate.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Diamond
programme.desc: Henrik Durvard has taken over the country of Lombuanada by a military coup, and holds the natives in terror. He has obtained a diamond from the native miners, and the IMF is assigned to take it away from him.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 105
programme.desc: Programleder Lisbeth Østergaard og de to ekspertene besøker Charlotte og Martin, som drømmer om å starte på ny frisk og flytte inn i et hus der de kan starte en familie.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 201
programme.desc: Programleder Camilla Ottesen, eiendomsmegler Tobias Edlev Nielsen og arkitekt Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besøker Ida og Aske på Østerbro. De har vært på jakt etter bolig i et år, men har ikke funnet drømmehjemmet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 202
programme.desc: Eiendomsmegleren Tobias og arkitekten Mads får en vanskelig oppgave, når de skal finne et hus til Lea og Sebastian fra Brønshøj.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 203
programme.desc: Vi besøker Camilla og Frederik i Frederiksberg, som er i desperat behov av hjelp, da leiligheten paret bor i skal selges snart. De har også lyst til å bo nærmere grøntområder.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 204
programme.desc: Pernille og Søren har et brennende ønske om å flytte tilbake til Horsens, hvor begge to har vokst opp. De har allerede solgt leiligheten, så Tobias får det travelt med å finne et hus til paret.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 13-Year-Old Father?
programme.desc: Curtis sat down with his mother Telisha, and told her that he is trying to have a baby but Telisha was shocked and terrified because Curtis is only 13 years old! Curtis insists he is ready to be a father.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
programme.desc: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
programme.desc: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lock the Door
programme.desc: Soon after the lifeless body of Charlie Tuttle was discovered behind a locked bedroom door, his death was ruled a suicide. But six months later, Kenda receives an unprompted confession .

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Officer Down
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda is faced with his worst nightmare when he learns a friend and fellow officer, Mark Dabling, has been killed in the line of duty.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: The night before Halloween, a real-life nightmare unfolds when a young man is found clinging to life. The case takes a dark turn when Lt. Joe Kenda learns there is a second victim somewhere in the woods.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Standoff
programme.desc: A disabled man is killed on the job, but Kenda’s case hits a roadblock when forensic evidence is scrubbed from the scene.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When a mysterious explosion rocks a sleepy suburb, it’s up to Kenda to ID a pile of charred remains and find the killer who triggered the blast.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.
